formal.scope: Boolean constraint equivalence and optimal-decision transport theorem
formal.source:
import Std

def Optimal {O A : Type} (S : O → A → Prop) (loss : O → A → Int)
    (o : O) (a : A) : Prop := S o a ∧ ∀ b, S o b → loss o a ≤ loss o b

theorem sameOptimal {O A : Type} (S T : O → A → Prop)
    (h : ∀ o a, S o a ↔ T o a) (loss : O → A → Int) (o : O) (a : A) :
    Optimal S loss o a ↔ Optimal T loss o a := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ha, hm⟩
    exact ⟨(h o a).mp ha, fun b hb => hm b ((h o b).mpr hb)⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hm⟩
    exact ⟨(h o a).mpr ha, fun b hb => hm b ((h o b).mp hb)⟩

theorem Certified : ∀ (_v0 _v1 _v2 : Bool), (_v0 && _v1 && _v2 && true && (!(!_v0)) && (_v1 || (_v1 && _v2)) && (_v2 || _v2)) = (_v0 && _v1 && _v2) := by decide

#print axioms Certified
#print axioms sameOptimal
